<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex074012025-11-2510-59-48" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon"> <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (199b5-199b8)"/>
        <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4663"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3706">shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan</rs> gyi rnam bshad legs par bshad pa rin po che'i snang ba</rs> zhes bya ba | <rs type="person" ana="">'gro ba'i mgon <lb n="199b6"/> po zhang rin po che'i</rs> <rs type="person" ana="">bu chen</rs>| <rs type="person" ana="">bla ma grub thob ti shri ras pa<anchor xml:id="a1"/>'i dbon po</rs> sngags mtshan nyid kyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3929">dge ba'i bshes gnyen kun dga' rgyal mtshan</rs> zhes bya bas snyim pa me tog dang bcas nas yang dang yang du gsol <lb n="199b7"/> ba btab pa'i ngor | <rs type="person" ana="">dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams</rs> kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir | <rs type="person" ana="">yongs 'dzin gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dka' 4 'dzin pa</rs> la stod pa <rs type="person" ana="">rgyal ba bzang po</rs>s kyang dang dngos cher byas nas bskul byed (dang sdeb sbyor) kyi rkyen sbyar te ? bde</seg></TEI>
